    A Career with TPL
    • Looking for an exciting opportunity to contribute to future economic growth of South Africa?

      Transnet is a world-class employer with a highly motivated workforce exceeding 55 000 permanent employees. We value their dedication and commitment and embrace the importance of ensuring the right skills, capabilities and improved capacity is sustainable in the long-term by helping our employees excel in achieving their desired potential.

      Our workplace reflects our dynamic and challenging environment and offers outstanding opportunities aiming at attracting results driven individuals who are suitably qualified and who have the necessary career prospects.

      Employment equity also remains a priority on our transformation agenda. Employing the best skilled people in the industry is vital to the success and sustainability of our company . It is through our staff that we realise our aspirations and deliver on our strategic goals and objectives.

Transnet Pipelines

Doing Business with Us


Transnet Pipelines (TPL)

The Preferred Partnering Choice


Integrated Supply Chain Solutions


At Transnet Pipelines, we deliver comprehensive pipeline network supply chain solutions that prioritise safety, ensure optimal service reliability, and consistently exceed customer expectations through the expertise of our highly-skilled workforce.


Strategic Initiatives


To enhance our capabilities, we are focused on securing a direct import terminal at the Port of Durban and obtaining a terminal operating license. This aligns with our strategic objectives under the Transnet Liquid Fuels Master Plan, aimed at:


Broad-Based Economic Empowerment


Encouraging new market participants in line with the Liquid Fuels Charter, promoting sector transformation.


Clean Fuels II Programme


Meeting the Department of Energy's requirements for increased import terminal capacity due to evolving fuel specifications.


Performance Highlights


Revenue: Increased by 8.9% to R5.7 billion.

EBITDA: Decreased by 4.7% to R3.8 billion.

Petroleum Volumes: Slight decrease of 0.3% to 17.8 billion litres.

Safety: Recorded a DIFR of 0.70 against a target of 0.60.


Infrastructure and Operations


New Multi-Product Pipeline (NMPP): The 24-inch trunk line, fully operational with a capacity of 148 Ml per week, transports two diesel grades (D10 and D50) and two unleaded petrol grades (93 and 95) as well as jet fuel.

Jameson Park Facility (TM2): Operational since December 2017, this inland accumulation facility in Gauteng has a capacity of 180 Ml, ensuring supply security to the inland economic hub and surrounding areas.

Durban to Johannesburg Pipeline (DJP): Currently being decommissioned, with completion expected in 2021. Plans are underway to repurpose the Durban to Pietermaritzburg segment to supply gas to industrial areas, pending demand validation.


Seamless Service Integration


Our integrated rail and pipeline services to OR Tambo International Airport guarantee jet fuel supply security. We are also working on optimising pipeline solutions for Cape Town International Airport.


Expanding Our Reach


Transnet Pipelines’ international strategy, led by Transnet International Holdings (TIH), aims to extend our operations beyond South Africa.


We are positioning Transnet Pipelines as the preferred liquid and gas terminal and pipeline operator across Africa, with plans to diversify into the liquefied natural gas (LNG) market domestically.
